subsystems.name: Microphone array
subsystems.role: captures ambient noise and the wearer's voice for the noise-cancellation and voice-isolation algorithms.
parts: MEMS microphone capsules (feedforward and feedback positions)

subsystems.name: Audio processing system-on-chip
subsystems.role: runs real-time digital signal processing and neural network inference to generate anti-noise and isolate voices.

subsystems.name: Acoustic drivers
subsystems.role: produce both the desired audio and the anti-noise signal that cancels unwanted sound.

subsystems.name: Wireless and power
subsystems.role: connects to the phone or computer and powers the earbuds.
parts: charging contacts or wireless charging coil

subsystems.name: Firmware and AI models
subsystems.role: the software that adapts noise cancellation in real time and separates speech from noise.
parts: neural network weights for voice isolation

buildSteps.title: Design the acoustic architecture
buildSteps.detail: Engineers place microphones and drivers to maximise noise pickup and minimise feedback, using simulation of sound waves inside the ear canal and around the bud.

buildSteps.title: Fabricate MEMS microphones
buildSteps.detail: Silicon wafers are micromachined to create tiny diaphragms and backplates, then diced and packaged with sound ports.

buildSteps.title: Manufacture the drivers
buildSteps.detail: Coils, magnets and diaphragms are assembled into miniature speakers, then tested for frequency response and distortion.

buildSteps.title: Assemble the circuit board
buildSteps.detail: The system-on-chip, memory, Bluetooth radio and power management are soldered onto a flexible or rigid PCB.

buildSteps.title: Train the AI models
buildSteps.detail: Recordings of many noise environments and voices are used to train neural networks that separate speech or predict anti-noise, then the models are compressed for low-power inference.

buildSteps.title: Integrate firmware
buildSteps.detail: The models are optimised to run within a few milliseconds on the earbud's DSP and NPU, because even small delays ruin cancellation.

buildSteps.title: Assemble the earbuds
buildSteps.detail: Drivers, microphones, PCB, battery and antennas are fitted into the shell, sealed against sweat and dust, and the two earbuds are paired.

buildSteps.title: Calibrate and test
buildSteps.detail: Each unit is measured in an acoustic test chamber to verify noise reduction, voice isolation and audio quality, and to ensure safe maximum volume.

prerequisites.why: tiny, low-power microphones are needed to sense noise inside and outside the ear.
running AI models in real time on a battery-powered device is possible but still constrained by power and heat.
